incidents.name: PerpPair
incidents.notes: Attacker acted as both LP and trader: an oversized long skewed PerpPair's virtual AMM and the LP immediately realized inflated PnL, a mechanism-design flaw with no code defect or external oracle.

sources.ref: Onchain review: PerpPair 0xb68396dd4230253d27589e2004ac37389836ae17 created 2026-03-03T14:30:44Z (Linea block 29416825) by 0x5b3e4794103d3f940f1a8d84652f3298b5d0b6f4, not the attack-tx sender 0x8d6778d7fae00ad2e0bc12194cf03b756fed9db3. keccak(eth_getCode) is identical at the creation block and the incident block 30067821, neither the EIP-1967 implementation nor the beacon slot is set, and all four addresses executed in the victim's context during the exploit (0xf1b5180b7aeabd55a9c57e53e31685a6e6ef7ae8, 0x0ef31752a4d7bef5a46b378873613f706255b9cd, 0x95776062d4e200a6ea701ea8114ab32b871c8f00, 0x78197fe93999e34d5a688e1819923c66dcf8f4db) are PUSH20 link-time library constants in the runtimes that call them. Deployment basis is exact.
